entity.title: Merge decisions
entity.description: When the action may merge a pull request it approved, and how.

rules.body: The action MUST NOT merge a pull request unless the matching policy enables merging, and merging MUST be disabled by default.
The action MUST merge with the configured merge token and MUST NOT merge with the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN, because a merge by that token starts no workflow.
The action MUST merge only the head commit it evaluated, and only when GitHub reports the pull request as cleanly mergeable.
The action MUST use the merge method the policy names, or else the one the base branch rules allow, and MUST NOT merge when the two disagree.
The action MUST NOT merge a release pull request while the source branch holds a commit the changelog would show.
